meta.note: Original sayings and values for the Orderborne 'Dedicated' feature, which asks the player to record three. Setting-neutral; no gods, orders or places are named.

orderborneSayings: A promise kept is a wall that never falls.
The many are stronger than the one.
Every tool has its purpose; so does every person.
Order is a kindness we give to each other.
Rise before the sun, rest after the work.
Respect is earned in deeds, not words.
Guard the gate you were given.
